STARTFILE.description: The default starting URL file path if none is specified on the command line or via WWW_HOME.

HELPFILE.description: The local path to the lynx_help main page, prefixed with file://localhost.

DEFAULT_INDEX_FILE.description: The default file retrieved when the user presses the 'I' key.

SESSION_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of searched strings, goto URLs, visited links and history entries saved in session file.

CHARACTER_SET.description: The display character set MIME name.

LOCALE_CHARSET.description: Overrides CHARACTER_SET if true, using the current locale to lookup a MIME name.

DEFAULT_CACHE_SIZE.description: The number of WWW documents to be cached in memory at one time.

TRUSTED_LYNXCGI.description: Defines permitted sources and/or paths for lynxcgi links.
